# 360yield
> Improve Digital Origin.

360yield provides digital advertising and monetization technology focused on yield optimization, header bidding, ad serving, and programmatic revenue operations for publishers.

## Platform
- [Home](https://www.360yield.com/): Overview of 360yield’s publisher monetization and yield optimization platform.
- [Products](https://www.360yield.com/products/): Summary of core monetization, ad serving, and optimization products.
- [Solutions](https://www.360yield.com/solutions/): Overview of platform solutions for publishers and digital media businesses.
- [Company](https://www.360yield.com/company/): Background information about the company, mission, and business focus.
- [Contact](https://www.360yield.com/contact/): Contact information for sales, partnerships, and general inquiries.

## Products
- [Header Bidding](https://www.360yield.com/products/header-bidding/): Product information for header bidding management and demand optimization.
- [Ad Server](https://www.360yield.com/products/ad-server/): Details on ad serving capabilities for direct and programmatic campaigns.
- [Yield Optimization](https://www.360yield.com/products/yield-optimization/): Information on tools for maximizing publisher revenue and inventory value.
- [Programmatic](https://www.360yield.com/products/programmatic/): Overview of programmatic monetization and demand management features.
- [Analytics](https://www.360yield.com/products/analytics/): Reporting and analytics capabilities for revenue and performance monitoring.

## Solutions
- [Publishers](https://www.360yield.com/solutions/publishers/): Solution overview tailored to digital publishers and media owners.
- [Media Companies](https://www.360yield.com/solutions/media-companies/): Information for larger media organizations managing monetization at scale.
- [Revenue Optimization](https://www.360yield.com/solutions/revenue-optimization/): Approaches for improving ad yield and operational efficiency.
- [Programmatic Monetization](https://www.360yield.com/solutions/programmatic-monetization/): Solution details for increasing programmatic revenue performance.
